description: Join Chintu the elephant and Mithu the parrot as they discover a magical surprise under a colorful umbrella. A fun and vibrant learning video for toddlers to enjoy! #Shorts #KidsRhymes #Cartoon

scenes.text: Arrey! Chintu ke umbrella ke neeche kya hai?
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, 3D render, Chintu the orange baby elephant with blue scarf looking surprised at a large vibrant red closed umbrella, cute forest background, soft sunlight.

scenes.text: Mithu, jaldi bolo, one, two, three!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, 3D render, Mithu the green parrot with a red cap flapping wings excitedly above Chintu, both staring at the umbrella.
Vertical 9:16, 3D render, The red umbrella springing open with golden sparkles floating in the air, Chintu and Mithu look amazed.
Vertical 9:16, 3D render, Hundreds of glowing yellow bubbles floating out from under the umbrella, Chintu trying to pop them with his trunk.
Vertical 9:16, 3D render, Chintu laughing while popping bubbles, Mithu riding on top of the umbrella handle, bright and joyful colors.

scenes.text: Dhoom macha ke, dance karo mere saath!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, 3D render, Chintu doing a happy elephant dance, wiggling his ears, Mithu dancing mid-air, confetti raining down.

scenes.text: Yay! Magic umbrella is so much fun!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, 3D render, Chintu and Mithu hugging, big joyful smiles, camera close-up on their happy faces, vibrant aesthetic.

scenes.text: Ruko! Umbrella ke neeche phir se dekho...
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, 3D render, Chintu slowly closing the umbrella while winking at the camera, mystery atmosphere, seamless loop transition style.
